reserveReview.rationale: The issuer-published September 28, 2026 20:00 UTC portfolio contains seven positions totaling $312,910,926.57: State Street Galaxy SWEEP $151,267,661.89 (48.3421%), BlackRock BUIDL $101,801,009.67 (32.5335%), Franklin BENJI $37,098,305.23 (11.8559%), Fidelity FYOXX $22,023,264.78 (7.0382%), Coinbase USDC cash equivalents $500,002.80 (0.1598%), Other Assets $121,045.25 (0.0387%), and Silicon Valley Bank deposits $99,636.95 (0.0318%). The ondo-ousg adapter reads the dated amounts and stable document IDs directly. BUIDL, BENJI and USDC are direct collateral dependencies; SWEEP and FYOXX are named untracked fund shares, while bank deposits and Other Assets remain separate. The Other Assets funds-in-transit line persists in the issuer's own current data, so the residual known-unknown cannot be reconciled to zero from issuer evidence and the exact-0 curated-fallback gate stays blocked. Low legacy risk for named Treasury/liquidity fund shares follows the conservative tokenized-fund tier; bank deposits are medium and unresolved net receivables high. This is issuer-reported composition, not an independent audit or examination; no dated independent attestor report is retrievable from a stable public URL (the former report folder is sign-in-gated), so the audited-fallback path also remains closed. Existing separate assurance/custody limitations are unchanged, and the published scope excludes OUSG limited partnership interests represented in non-tokenized book-entry form.
